Restore a new graph from a checkpoint and a registry of recipes (R-checkpoint).

## Import

```ts
import { restoreGraph } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
```

## Signature

```ts
function restoreGraph(
	checkpoint: GraphCheckpoint,
	options: RestoreGraphOptions,
): Graph
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `checkpoint` | `GraphCheckpoint` | A `graphrefly-ts/checkpoint@1` checkpoint. |
| `options` | `RestoreGraphOptions` | The registry of recipe factories, restore extensions and named definitions, and optional dispatcher and versioning overrides. |

## Returns

A new graph with no subscribers; no recipe function has run.

## Example

```ts
import { defaultRestoreRegistry, graph, restoreGraph } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";

const original = graph();
const restored = restoreGraph(original.checkpoint(), { registry: defaultRestoreRegistry });
```
